footerSettings: You are receiving this email because you are a member of this team on {productName}. To stop receiving this type of email: {settingsUrl}

autopilotPreviewReady.subject: Your first forms are ready to review
autopilotPreviewReady.heading: Your first forms are ready
autopilotPreviewReady.body: The autopilot of the “{campaign}” campaign has prepared its first {count} forms. Review them: nothing is sent until you confirm.

autopilotDoneTarget.subject: “{campaign}”: {sent} businesses contacted
autopilotDoneTarget.heading: Target reached
autopilotDoneTarget.body: The autopilot of the “{campaign}” campaign is done: {sent} businesses contacted out of {target} planned.

autopilotDoneEmpty.subject: “{campaign}”: no one left to contact
autopilotDoneEmpty.heading: No businesses left to contact
autopilotDoneEmpty.body: The autopilot of the “{campaign}” campaign stopped after {sent} contacts: every business found has been contacted. Widen the search to find more.

searchDone.subject: Search finished: {prospects} businesses found
searchDone.heading: Search finished
searchDone.body: The search of the “{campaign}” campaign is finished: {prospects} businesses found. You can now contact them.

searchDoneKept.subject: Search finished: {prospects} prospects kept
searchDoneKept.heading: Search finished
searchDoneKept.body: The search of the “{campaign}” campaign is finished: {prospects} prospects kept, the ones matching your target. You can now contact them.

searchNoCredits.subject: Search stopped: no credits left
searchNoCredits.heading: Your search is paused
searchNoCredits.body: The search of the “{campaign}” campaign stopped: you have no credits left ({prospects} businesses already found). Upgrade your plan to resume right away, or wait for the renewal.

creditsLowDiscovery.subject: Less than 20% of your credits left
creditsLowDiscovery.heading: Credits running low
creditsLowDiscovery.body: You have {remaining} credits left out of {quota}. Next refill: {renewal}.

adminSubscriptionCanceled.subject: Cancellation: {team}
adminSubscriptionCanceled.heading: Subscription cancelled
adminSubscriptionCanceled.body: The “{team}” team ({owner}) asked to cancel its subscription. It stays active until {endsAt}.

adminPaymentFailed.subject: Payment failed: {team}
adminPaymentFailed.heading: Payment failed
adminPaymentFailed.body: The payment of the “{team}” team ({owner}) failed (status: {status}).
